# SEO-605: Back infinite scroll with crawlable paginated URLs

## Statement

A list that loads more items as the reader scrolls also exposes each batch at its own URL reachable through an anchor, and requesting that URL directly returns the same items the scroll would have appended.

## Rationale

Items appended by a scroll handler exist only inside the session that scrolled, so a list that grows only on scroll has exactly one crawlable page no matter how many items it contains.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site",
    "pagination"
  ],
  "any": [
    "client_rendered",
    "javascript_app"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Give each batch a URL the server can render on its own and link to the next batch with an anchor, then let the scroll handler enhance that link rather than replace it. Keep the item ordering stable so a given URL returns the same batch on a later request.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Request each batch URL directly and compare the items returned against those the scroll interaction appends at the same position.
- Evidence: `ROUTE`, `RENDERED_HTML`, `BROWSER`
- Automated check: none.
